verdict.rationale: Muse lets users personalize their single agent's name, persona/style, and give it access to personal knowledge/files (muse-docs-2, muse-docs-17, muse-supp-vm-files-export), and it can build its own tools/connectors (muse-docs-7, muse-docs-14), which loosely maps to custom-assistant creation. However there is no evidence of a mechanism to build multiple distinct named assistants or to share them with other users, which is central to the story. Missing for 10: multi-assistant creation workflow, explicit sharing/publishing feature for custom assistants, evidence of others using a shared assistant.
